cat /tmp/cf_final.txt | grep -oP 'https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com' | head -1

args.command:
cd /root/.nanobot/workspace/mario_game/build/web && python3 -c "
import json, urllib.request, sys
from pathlib import Path

cfg = json.loads(Path.home().joinpath('.nanobot/config.json').read_text())
token = cfg['channels']['telegram']['token']
chat_id = '$NANOBOT_CHAT_ID'

# Send document via Telegram Bot API
url = f'https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendDocument'
files = {
    'document': ('mario.html', open('mario.html', 'rb'), 'text/html'),
    'chat_id': (None, chat_id),
    'caption': (None, '🎮 Super Mario Bros — 纯JS版，浏览器直接打开')
}
import io
# Use multipart form data
boundary = '----WebKitFormBoundary7MA4YWxkTrZu0gW'
body = []
for key, (name, value, ctype) in files.items():
    body.append(f'--{boundary}'.encode())
    if ctype:
        body.append(f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{key}\"; filename=\"{name}\"'.encode())
        body.append(f'Content-Type: {ctype}'.encode())
    else:
        body.append(f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{key}\"'.encode())
    body.append(b'')
    if isinstance(value, io.BufferedReader):
        body.append(value.read())
    else:
        body.append(str(value).encode())
body.append(f'--{boundary}--'.encode())
body_data = b'\r\n'.join(body)

req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_data)
req.add_header('Content-Type', f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}')
resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
print(f'Send status: {resp.status}')
print(resp.read().decode()[:200])
"
